blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is gearing up for Earth Day with a series of exciting events and initiatives throughout March and April.
The festivities kicked off with “Fashion Forward” at Robinsons Galleria, a showcase of stylish and sustainable clothing made from upcycled, ethically-sourced, and organic materials.
From March 21-22, turn trash into cash! The Robinsons Novaliches Recycling Market offers a chance to participate in waste management and earn some rewards.
Make e-waste disposal a breeze with Robinsons Malls-Smart E-Waste Bins located at select malls. Robinsons Galleria’s Renew-a-Bottle Machine rewards you with vouchers for used plastic bottles.
On March 23, join the nationwide Global Switch Off and participate in Earth Hour activities at Robinsons Malls. Enjoy dazzling light shows, captivating dance performances, and more!
Unleash your creativity with ‘Art for Earth Paint by Numbers’ mural painting activities happening on March 23-24 and April 20-21 at select Robinsons Malls.
The Dreamify Festival takes place at Robinsons Metro East from April 27-28. Expect inspiring art exhibits, local performances, and interactions with eco-conscious brands.
